description: This file defines the VTScheduledReport class, which manages scheduled report generation, email distribution, and trigger timing within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: VTScheduledReport
classes.description: A class extending Reports to handle scheduled report execution, email notifications, and timing logic within vtiger CRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing database, user, and report ID, and calling parent constructor.

methods.name: getReportScheduleInfo
methods.description: Retrieves and caches scheduling info for the report.

methods.name: getRecipientEmails
methods.description: Gathers email addresses of report recipients based on stored recipient info.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Generates and sends the scheduled report via email with attachments.

methods.name: getNextTriggerTime
methods.description: Calculates the next scheduled trigger time based on the report's schedule interval.

methods.name: updateNextTriggerTime
methods.description: Updates the database with the next trigger time for the report.

methods.name: generateRecipientOption
methods.description: Creates HTML option tags for recipients based on type and ID.

methods.name: getAvailableUsersHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML select element with all users.

methods.name: getAvailableGroupsHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML select element with all groups.

methods.name: getAvailableRolesHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML select element with all roles.

methods.name: getAvailableRolesAndSubordinatesHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML select element with all roles and subordinates.

methods.name: getScheduledReports
methods.description: Fetches all reports scheduled to run at or before the current time.

methods.name: runScheduledReports
methods.description: Executes all scheduled reports that are due, sending emails and updating trigger times.
